total.description: Total planned material lines matching the filters (all pages); not a count of work orders or items.

total_pages.description: Number of pages for this query.

has_more.description: True if there are more pages after this one.

date_field.description: Work order date the range applied to (reportdate by default).

date_from.description: Start date applied (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive); null if no date filter.

date_to.description: End date applied (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive); null if no date filter.

filters.description: Normalized filters applied, by parameter name.

balances_truncated.description: Only with include_balance: true if more than 2000 balance rows matched this page; use a smaller page_size.

items.description: Planned material lines in this page, ordered by wonum, siteid and wpitemid. Only the requested fields are present; location is the storeroom; dates are yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss in server time. With include_balance, each line has balance: null without storeroom, else {total, bins: [{binnum, lotnum, conditioncode, curbal}]}.

error.description: Present only when the request is invalid. No other field is returned.
